# PostgreSQL

> > The world's most advanced open source relational database system, maintained by the PostgreSQL Global Development Group with a vibrant global community.

PostgreSQL is a powerful, enterprise-class open source database that supports both SQL and JSON querying. The site provides official documentation, downloads, community events, and resources for developers and database administrators worldwide.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL database
- Open source RDBMS
- SQL and JSON support
- PostgreSQL Global Development Group
- Community events and conferences
- PGConf and PGDay events
- PostgreSQL releases and versions
- Database features and extensions
- PostGIS spatial database
- Corporate sponsors (Crunchy Data, EDB, Microsoft)
- PostgreSQL Europe
- Community Code of Conduct
- Database administration
- PostgreSQL development
- Feature matrix and version comparison

## Getting Started

- [PostgreSQL Homepage](https://www.postgresql.org): PostgreSQL homepage with releases, events, and community resources

## Documentation and Reference

- [Feature Matrix](https://www.postgresql.org/about/featurematrix): Feature comparison matrix across PostgreSQL versions
- [64-bit Large Objects Feature](https://www.postgresql.org/about/featurematrix/detail/64-bit-large-objects): 64-bit large objects feature description and storage limits

## Community and Events

- [PGConf.EU 2024](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/pgconfeu-2024-2507): PostgreSQL Conference Europe 2024 in Athens, Greece with training
- [PostgreSQL Development Conference 2026 (pgconf.dev)](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/postgresql-development-conference-2026-pgconfdev-2543): PostgreSQL Development Conference 2026 in Vancouver for contributors
- [Postgres Extensions Day 2025](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/postgres-extensions-day-2025-2536): Postgres Extensions Day 2025 in Montreal with CFP for extension devs
- [PostGIS Day 2025](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/postgis-day-2025-2557): PostGIS Day 2025 online geospatial event on Zoom and YouTube
- [FOSSASIA PGDay 2026](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/fossasia-pgday-2026-2563): FOSSASIA PGDay 2026 conference in Bangkok with CFP and sponsors
- [PG Down Under 2025](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/pg-down-under-2025-2547): PG Down Under 2025 conference in Sydney with CFP and sponsorships
- [PGDay Chicago 2024](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/pgday-chicago-2024-2493): PGDay Chicago 2024 community event for PostgreSQL users
